label: Must-repair analysis
subgoals: Count the faulty cells in each row and each column
Mark rows with more faults than spare columns as must-repair rows
Mark columns with more faults than spare rows as must-repair columns

label: Minimum cover
subgoals: Build the bipartite graph of rows, columns and faulty cells
Find a maximum matching of the graph
Read the minimum number of lines from König's theorem

label: Repair with limited rows
subgoals: Try each choice of at most R rows to replace
Count the distinct columns among the remaining faults
Take the minimum over the choices
